verdict.rationale: A desktop app for visual diff review and side-by-side sessions is a fair question for a coding agent, so the axis applies. The evidence describes Mastra Code only as a terminal-based agent with a TUI, headless mode and programmatic embedding. Nothing documents a desktop app, a visual diff viewer or parallel sessions shown side by side.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review diffs visually and run multiple sessions side by side in a desktop app
